about.title: My Story
about.body: Hello, and thank you for visiting my site! My name is Courtney and I am a mother of two lovely, beautiful daughters. Early in my life I discovered that I had a passion for photography, and the birth of my daughters deepened that passion. It was a joy to capture their special moments, and it often makes my heart ache to revisit those moments years later. Photography is a craft unlike any other, and it is my goal to share my skill with you and to help capture your family's moments.

testimonials.quote: We love Courtney. She is amazing with my kids and that's the most important thing. My girls beg me for pictures with Ms. Courtney!! And of course I'm never disappointed with the pics!
testimonials.author: Jen D.

testimonials.quote: Courtney has the patience of a saint and the eye of an artist! She perfectly captures the essence of our kids!
testimonials.author: Emily W.

testimonials.quote: Courtney Anton is an extremely talented photographer, and when you can trust a complete stranger with your baby in your house, you know you've got a great person hired for the job. Her prices are also the best around.
testimonials.author: Candace B.

portfolioIntro: Photography is all about holding life still for just that one moment. It's about taking every precious slice of time and turning it into a memory that will last forever. There is nothing more beautiful than the innocence of a child, and it is my mission to capture this magic and give you something irreplaceable to forever hold dear to your heart. We cannot stop time from racing by, but by putting yourself in the pilot's seat, you can make one single second last for a lifetime.

galleries.title: Newborn
galleries.description: Make the gift of life last forever with professional and personal photographs of your new bundle of joy. With the right lens and the right angle, we can craft art that you won't be able to take your eyes off of.

galleries.title: Baby
galleries.description: They truly do grow up far too fast, don't they? For their first birthday—or really any milestone—it's important to pause time just for a moment to capture the beauty and make it last forever.

galleries.title: Child
galleries.description: Curious, creative, loving: our children are already an undeniable and precious work of art—we're just here to celebrate it and create a timeless memory for the whole family to cherish forever.

galleries.title: Maternity
galleries.description: Just because you haven't met them yet, doesn't mean you don't love them unconditionally—and vice versa! All you need to do is bring your bump and enthusiasm. Let's make a shoot to remember!

galleries.title: Family
galleries.description: Calling all Moms, Dads, Grandparents, Kids, and more. There is great power in numbers, and the more the merrier around these parts! So gather the troops and let's make some memories.

contact.intro: Here at Courtney Anton Photography, you come first—always—which is why we constantly strive to ignite new ideas as to how we can make you as happy as possible.

faqs.question: When should I schedule a newborn session?
faqs.answer: Schedule before your baby arrives to ensure your date is available. You'll be placed on the calendar based on your due date. The key is photographing within the first 10 days of life — newborns sleep less and lose their "womb-like" flexibility after ten days.

faqs.question: When are maternity sessions best?
faqs.answer: Maternity sessions are often best between 32–37 weeks.

faqs.question: Where do you travel for sessions?
faqs.answer: I shoot on-location and will travel up to 1 hour 10 minutes from my home in Hanover, PA at no additional charge. There's a travel fee for locations outside that range.

faqs.question: What should I expect from a newborn session?
faqs.answer: Newborn sessions average ~3 hours in the comfort of your home. I shoot in all natural light, so I'll need a space with windows or a large light source. Please turn up the heat — baby will spend much of the session in the nude. I bring props but love incorporating sentimental touches from your home (baby blankets, nursery, etc.).

faqs.question: When will I see my photos?
faqs.answer: Within 3–6 weeks of your session you'll receive an online, password-protected viewing gallery. Sneak peeks may appear on my Facebook or blog before then. Once payment is received, final products arrive within three weeks (unless otherwise specified).
